title: Dialogue and question sheet
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Reading dialogues: a school event; getting to know each other; the heater
source: Written for arabic/y6 lesson 6 (Dialogue and question sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 6: Reading dialogue: a school event. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

arabic.text: سَلْمَى: مَاذَا عِنْدَنَا يَوْمَ الخَمِيسِ؟ / خَالِدٌ: عِنْدَنَا مُسَابَقَةُ القُرْآنِ فِي المَدْرَسَةِ. / سَلْمَى: هَلْ تُشَارِكُ فِي المُسَابَقَةِ؟ / خَالِدٌ: نَعَمْ، سَأَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ المُلْكِ. / سَلْمَى: مَا شَاءَ اللّٰهُ! بِالتَّوْفِيقِ.
arabic.ref: Our own dialogue for 'a school event' (Kitabi version: CHECK IN KITABI)

panels.title: Question words
points: هَلْ؟ (hal?) a yes or no question

questions.q: Core: Answer in Arabic (portal response box): 1) مَاذَا عِنْدَهُمْ يَوْمَ الخَمِيسِ؟ 2) مَاذَا سَيَقْرَأُ خَالِدٌ؟
Extend: Read the dialogue with a partner in a breakout room, then swap parts.
Stretch: Change the dialogue: a different day and a different surah.
questions.a: For example: يَوْمَ الأَحَدِ ... سَأَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ النَّبَأِ.
B) سُورَةُ المُلْكِ. Khalid says سَأَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ المُلْكِ.

questions.q: What does مُسَابَقَة mean? A) competition B) school C) prize
Big question: how did you find the key information in the dialogue?
questions.a: By using the question words (what, when, where) and finding the line that answers them.
